name: Tablet PC production line solutions
summary: A complete line automation solution for tablet PC manufacturers, covering display assembly, battery installation, motherboard assembly, and final inspection and packaging.
contentHtml:
The tablet PC production line solution is a complete line automation solution provided by TXAM for tablet PC manufacturers.

Solution Composition

The entire line covers the full process including display module assembly, battery installation, motherboard assembly, cable connection, vision inspection, functional testing, appearance inspection, and automatic packaging.

Technical Advantages

  • Precision lamination of display modules with an accuracy of ±0.1mm
  • Automated battery installation compliant with safety standards
  • Precision motherboard assembly with high placement accuracy
  • AOI vision inspection with accurate defect recognition
  • Full functional testing to ensure product quality
  • Anti-static packaging to ensure product safety

Service Content

TXAM provides full-process support from solution design, equipment manufacturing, installation and commissioning to after-sales service.
